title: Steve from Minecraft
subtitle: Blocky diplomat. Keeper of the MySpace relics.

quote.text: Steve from minecraft teamed up with quagmire to go to the famed city of “the projects” to meet osama bin bom’in to corrode-a-nate their terrorist attack on the italians of russia.

lead: **Steve from Minecraft** is a character in *The Legend of Chris* and, alongside his partner [[quagmire|Quagmire]], one of the three known [[myspace-relic-keepers|Keepers of the MySpace Relics]]. He is the default player character of the real-world video game *Minecraft*, and in the canon he appears to have retired from block-placing in favor of geopolitics.

sections.heading: Biography
sections.body:
In [[chapter-2]], Steve and Quagmire travel to the famed city of [[the-projects|the Projects]] to meet [[osama-bin-bomin|Osama Bin Bom'in]] and "corrode-a-nate" (sic) an attack on "the italians of russia". The pair's initial search is described as "good", as they quickly find a guide, [[mf-vroom|MF Vroom]]. Once the party reaches [[i-38-west|I-38 West]], however, Osama exiles their guide to the [[call-of-duty-lobbies|COD lobbies]], and Steve does not appear to object.

Steve and Quagmire then sit down with Osama to discuss "which Toyota Corolla should be responsible for the intital bombing run" (see [[toyota-corolla|The Toyota Corolla Question]]). The target is the Italian city of [[moscow|Moscow]], chosen because it hosted the [[mcdonalds-wine-brewing-contest|September 2002 McDonald's Wine Brewing contest]], which caused [[dairy-queen|DQ]] to start [[dq-mcdonalds-beef|beef on MySpace]] with [[mcdonalds|McDonald's]]. As relic keepers, the trio "wasnt cool with this C tier beef" and resolved to "let DQ win already".

The meeting ends with [[lightning-mcqueen|Lightning McQueen]] chosen for the run and [[tyler-from-uber|Tyler from Uber]] booked as the getaway driver. Steve is not seen again after this meeting.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.body:
- Steve is never given a last name. The wiki has chosen not to read anything into this, unlike in the case of [[plankton|Plankton]].
- His motive is entirely about restaurant rivalry on [[myspace|MySpace]], which makes him the only character in the canon to go to war over a social media comment section.

title: Quagmire
subtitle: Steve's partner in relic-keeping.
lead: **Quagmire** is a character in *The Legend of Chris*, the partner of [[steve-from-minecraft|Steve from Minecraft]] and one of the three [[myspace-relic-keepers|Keepers of the MySpace Relics]]. In the real world, Glenn Quagmire is a neighbor of [[peter-griffin-ringtone|Peter Griffin]] on the animated series *Family Guy*.

sections.heading: Biography
sections.body:
In [[chapter-2]], Quagmire "teamed up" with Steve to travel to [[the-projects|the Projects]] and meet [[osama-bin-bomin|Osama Bin Bom'in]]. Together they hired [[mf-vroom|MF Vroom]] as a guide, watched him get exiled, and then helped Osama decide which Toyota Corolla should lead the [[moscow-bombing|attack on Moscow]].

The narrator notes that "osama, Steve, and quagmire we're not happy" about the [[dq-mcdonalds-beef|DQ–McDonald's beef]], and that "being keepers of the MySpace relics they wasnt cool with this C tier beef." Quagmire speaks no dialogue in the canon, and his opinions are only known collectively.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.body:
- Quagmire is one of two *Family Guy* figures in the canon; the other, Peter Griffin, appears only as [[mf-vroom|MF Vroom]]'s ringtone.
- Quagmire's famous catchphrase from the show is never said. Editors consider this the most restrained moment in the book.

title: Osama Bin Bom'in
subtitle: Frat bro. Ruler of the Projects. Ignorer of mustard gas.

infobox.Also spelled: Bin Bom'in, Bin' bombin, Bin Bomb'in, Bin' Bombin
infobox.Title: Ruler of [[the-projects|the Projects]]

quote.text: Osama Bin Bomb'in. He was a frat member of the Pol Phi Doros with Koolaid College.

lead: **Osama Bin Bom'in** (spelled at least four different ways in the canon) is the ruler of [[the-projects|the Projects]] and one of the main antagonists of *The Legend of Chris*. A former fraternity brother who seized power in a palace coup, he coordinated the [[moscow-bombing|Attack on Moscow]], exiled [[mf-vroom|MF Vroom]] to the [[call-of-duty-lobbies|Call of Duty lobbies]], and commands an arsenal of giant robots. He is rumored to have "connections with Chris".

sections.heading: Rise to power
sections.body:
According to [[son-s-sonionring|Son S. Sonionring]], MF Vroom and Son built [[o-block|O'Block]] up "to its glory". But "once O'block had a nation around it the frat bros rose up, One in particular… Osama Bin Bomb'in." Osama, a member of [[pol-phi-doros|Pol Phi Doros]] at [[koolaid-college|Koolaid College]], showed up on Vroom's porch with his brothers and demanded that O'Block join [[european-union|the EU]]. When MF Vroom declined "because the Projects are in the americas not Europe", they "stormed his palace and gained complete control". See [[oblock-coup|The O'Block Coup]].

### Continuity note
This account comes from [[chapter-4-point-1]]. In [[chapter-2]], however, MF Vroom is introduced as a "long lost relative of the project's royal family" whom Osama exiles on sight, which suggests either that Vroom was deposed twice or that the narrator had not yet decided. The book itself admits, "We forgot to mention this in the prologue".

sections.heading: The Moscow affair
sections.body:
In [[chapter-2]], Osama receives [[steve-from-minecraft|Steve from Minecraft]] and [[quagmire|Quagmire]] at [[i-38-west|I-38 West]], the heart of the Projects. Upon their arrival he sends their guide MF Vroom into exile "to forever get yelled at in COD lobbies." He and his guests then settle [[toyota-corolla|which Toyota Corolla]] will lead the bombing run on [[moscow|Moscow]], all to settle the [[dq-mcdonalds-beef|DQ–McDonald's MySpace beef]] in DQ's favor. As one of the [[myspace-relic-keepers|Keepers of the MySpace Relics]], he takes this beef personally.

While leaving the Projects, Osama was ambushed by [[qxc|QXC]] and [[jinxy|Jinxy]]. "Osama not knowing who they we're ignored the mustard gas being deployed in this area and left without injury." Fan wikis widely agree this is the most effective use of ignoring something in recorded history.

sections.heading: The O Block 2 era
sections.body:
"In the begining of the O'block 2 era, when It was being scaled to be a EU level nation, Osama Bin' Bombin created monolithically sized defensive bio-robotic weapons robots", the [[ton-robots|TON robots]]. The most infamous of these is [[ton-618|TON 618]] ("Terrible Offensive Nuhuh"), kept in [[dpf-facility-69420|DPF Facility 69420]] and described as "the projects flagship defense".

When MF Vroom returns in [[chapter-4-point-1]], Osama's ambassador [[tung-tung-tung-sahur|Tung Tung Tung Sahur]] attempts to arrest him at the [[projects-national-spaceport|national spaceport]]. Son reports that "Osama knows we're here", and Osama responds by unleashing TON 618 on the city. MF Vroom theorizes that this is because of [[the-prophecy|the Prophecy]]: "If he knows our end goal already and he has connections with Chris.. That has to be why."

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.body:
- His name is a pun. The wiki does not elaborate.
- Spellings recorded: "bin bom'in", "Bin Bom'in", "Bin' bombin", "Bin Bomb'in" and "Bin' Bombin". This wiki uses the first spelling the canon gives.
- He is the only character in the canon who is both a keeper of the MySpace relics and a fraternity brother. Whether Pol Phi Doros has a MySpace page is unknown.
- Osama is never seen on-page after [[chapter-2]]; his later actions are told only through other characters and giant robots.

title: MF Vroom
subtitle: A car wearing a robe. Rightful king of the Projects. Former baller.

infobox.Also spelled: MF vroom, Mf Vroom, MF. V'room, MF V'room, MF'Vroom

quote.text: back in the day I used to be a baller on the court, I played Wemby, Curry, even Bronny… But all that changed when chris took balling all for himself!

lead: **MF Vroom** is a character in *The Legend of Chris*: a car wearing a robe, a long-lost relative of [[projects-royal-family|the Projects' royal family]], and the rightful ruler of [[o-block|O'Block]]. Exiled by [[osama-bin-bomin|Osama Bin Bom'in]] to "forever get yelled at in COD lobbies", he is sought out by [[rfk|RFK]] and [[plankton|Plankton]] as the first member of the [[new-crips|New Crips]], "Everyone's last hope of universalizing Balling".

sections.heading: Biography
sections.body:
### Guide and exile
MF Vroom first appears in [[chapter-2]] as the guide hired by [[steve-from-minecraft|Steve from Minecraft]] and [[quagmire|Quagmire]] to "traverse the projects". The narrator explains he "was a long lost relative of the project's royal family and was keen on returning to the top." Upon reaching [[i-38-west|I-38 West]], he "was send into exile by Osama Bin Bom'in to forever get yelled at in COD lobbies. MF Vroom was never seen again…"

He was, in fact, seen again.

### The search
In [[chapter-triangle]], RFK rejects [[mark-zuckerberg|Mark Zuckerberg]] as an ally and proposes: "MF Vroom, if we can restore him to power in the projects we can harness the power of the gang army". Locating him requires a trip to [[cod-hq|Call of Duty HQ]], deep in [[dunder-mifflin|Dunder Mifflin]]. There the party meets [[ioannus-paranukus|Ioann-ius Nukian]], a Jedi master "of the projects" who wishes to "free my king".

### Escape
In [[chapter-4-point-1]], the party enters the [[chambers-360|360 chambers]], and "from the shadows lept a fuckig car wearing a robe." Plankton throws his [[metal-folding-chair|metal chair]] at him before realizing who it is. Vroom explains: "I escaped the COD lobbies but for days now ive been roaming these hallways trying to find a way out!" An ethereal voice tells him, "Bruh just leave", and a door appears. On boarding the [[mercedes-benz-system-cruiser|Mercedes Benz System Cruiser]], his first words are "Bro where's the usb port". It was never found.

### Return to the Projects
On the flight home, Vroom takes a call on his [[windows-phone|Windows phone]] (ringtone: [[peter-griffin-ringtone|Peter Griffin]] "singing some choir something") from [[spamton|Spamton G. Spamton]], his "bestie" from Alpha Mogger Beta. At the [[projects-national-spaceport|Projects National Spaceport]], [[tung-tung-tung-sahur|Tung Tung Tung Sahur]] tries to arrest him, but Vroom's old right-hand man [[son-s-sonionring|Son]] appears with a [[modded-colonial-musket|modded colonial musket]]. During the drive to O'Block, Son explains how Osama's frat stormed Vroom's palace after Vroom refused to join [[european-union|the EU]] (see [[oblock-coup|The O'Block Coup]]). The chapter ends with Vroom revealing [[the-prophecy|the Prophecy]] and the presence of [[facebook-pre-cringe|Facebook (Pre-Cringe)]] in the [[projects-national-archives|national archives]].

sections.heading: Balling career
sections.body: Vroom claims he was once "a baller on the court" who played [[wemby-curry-bronny|Wemby, Curry, even Bronny]] before [[chris|Chris]] "took balling all for himself". This makes him one of the few characters with a personal grievance against Chris, rather than a cosmic one.

sections.heading: Personality
sections.body: Vroom is relaxed to the point of serenity. He describes his escape as feeling like he "role played as a Redditor touching grass outside his chud ahh house", and he calls RFK "Ronald F Kennedy Jr." without anyone correcting him. During his college years he took part in a xp candy packaging operation as part of Alpha Mogger Beta hazing, which he describes as "the high life".

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.body:
- He is never explicitly identified as a specific car model, although Plankton asks someone aboard the ship why they are "built like a 2008 Honda accord". See [[toyota-corolla|The Toyota Corolla Question]].
- The narrator claims Son "went into hiding when MF Vroom was sent into exile in fear that he too would have to listen to xbox live 2009 lobbies until his end."
- Vroom's two reported origins (lost royal relative in [[chapter-2]], co-founder of O'Block in [[chapter-4-point-1]]) are not necessarily contradictory, but editors have argued about it at length.

title: Lightning McQueen
subtitle: Toyota Corolla. Chick-fil-A loyalist. Knight of 4chan. Goober.

quote.text: Can I get two number 9s, a number 9 large a number 6 with extra DIEP a number 7 two number 45’s, one with cheese, and a large soda

lead: **Lightning McQueen** is a character in *The Legend of Chris*, described as a Toyota Corolla, "a chickfilla loyalist and a knight of 4chan". He carried out the [[moscow-bombing|Attack on Moscow]], lived with [[george-constanta|George Constanta]] for a time, and later joined [[agent-007|Agent 007]] and [[mr-bean|Mr. Bean]] as part of the [[goober-gang|Goober Gang]] to bring down [[constantinople|Constantinople]]. In the real world, Lightning McQueen is the race car hero of Pixar's *Cars*, and he is not a Toyota Corolla.

sections.heading: Moscow
sections.body: In [[chapter-2]], [[osama-bin-bomin|Osama Bin Bom'in]], [[steve-from-minecraft|Steve from Minecraft]] and [[quagmire|Quagmire]] discuss [[toyota-corolla|which Toyota Corolla]] should make the initial bombing run on [[moscow|Moscow]]. "The Toyota Corolla to do the initial bombing run was to be lightning McQueen". The plan was to have [[tyler-from-uber|Tyler from Uber]] "Uber him out of there", but "the attack on Moscow left lightning McQueen 'blasted' and moved in with George Constanta instead".

sections.heading: England
sections.body: In [[chapter-triangle]], McQueen, now in "the Soviet Union", grows "sick of George Constanta" and flies to [[england|England]] to meet a contact from [[parliament|parliament]]. A stranger had handed him [[the-pager|a pager]] instructing him "to hoard smoke detectors for parliament because of 'special reasons'". At the [[smoke-and-vape-shop|smoke and vape shop]] he meets Mr. Bean, who explains the mission: "take Constantinople away from the [[barack-empire|Barack Empire]] and Restore [[bernie-sanders|Bernie Sander's]] control over that area." McQueen's only concern is how to beat [[barack-obama|Barack Obama]], who holds [[seven-chaos-emeralds|the 7 chaos emeralds]]. Agent 007 says, "Ive heard stories about your work in Moscow I think your a Dope pick for the mission".

sections.heading: Constantinople
sections.body:
In [[chapter-the-fourth]], McQueen is tasked with planting the last two nukes in the [[abandoned-walmarts|old abandoned Walmarts]] on "the nadir side of the city". At the first Walmart he meets [[local-mafia|the local mafia]]; he "declined the request to be part of society and dropped off the nuke." The second target turns out to now be a [[popeyes|Popeyes]], where he places the order quoted above, pulls out his [[glock-19|Glock 19]], receives his food, and politely says "Thank you". He plants the nuke after eating.

He then picks up Mr. Bean and 007 at [[8aller-jump-street|8aller Jump Street]] and flies them into [[the-wormhole|a wormhole]] "just north of [[dababy|Dababy]]'s last known location". Constantinople fell "at 14:74pm [[unc-standard-time|Unc standard time]]", and "that was the last anyone heard from the goober gang for now…"

sections.heading: Continuity errors
sections.body:
- McQueen is a Chick-fil-A loyalist, yet his only on-page meal is from Popeyes. Loyalist scholars call this "an operational necessity".
- Moscow is called "the Italian city of Moscow" in [[chapter-2]], but McQueen is in "the Soviet Union" in [[chapter-triangle]].
- The mission was planned around defeating Barack Obama, but the man lured to the center of Constantinople is [[putin|Putin]], who is having coffee with Mr. Bean at the time. See [[fall-of-constantinople|The Fall of Constantinople]].
- He is spelled "lighting McQueen" twice.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.body:
- McQueen is listed first in the official Goober Gang roster that ends [[chapter-the-fourth]], ahead of 007 and Mr. Bean.
- Whether he flew to England as a passenger or as the airplane is never established.

title: Tyler from Uber
subtitle: The extraction plan that never was.
lead:
**Tyler from Uber** is a rideshare driver in *The Legend of Chris*, and the entire exit strategy for the [[moscow-bombing|Attack on Moscow]]. "The last part of their business was to figure out how to get lightning McQueen out of Moscow, their final verdict was to use Tyler from Uber to Uber him out of there."

Tyler was never used. After the attack, McQueen "moved in with [[george-constanta|George Constanta]] instead of returning by means of Tyler from Uber." Tyler is not mentioned again, and whether he waited outside Moscow, charged a cancellation fee, or was ever told is unknown.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.body:
- Hiring a car to pick up a car is considered one of the canon's great logistical puzzles.
- He shares a first name with [[ninja|Tyler Blevins]] and with the Tyler1 that [[angry-pope|the Angry Pope]] disguises himself as. No connection has been established.

title: QXC
subtitle: Mustard gas enthusiast. Ignored.
lead:
**QXC** is a character in *The Legend of Chris* known only for one ambush. As [[osama-bin-bomin|Osama Bin Bom'in]] was leaving [[the-projects|the Projects]] in [[chapter-2]], he "was ambushed by QXC and [[jinxy|Jinxy]]". The ambush did not work: "Osama not knowing who they we're ignored the mustard gas being deployed in this area and left without injury."

The canon never says who QXC is, why they ambushed Osama, or what happened to them next. The name likely refers to a real online personality, but editors have not confirmed this.

sections.heading: Analysis
sections.body: QXC and Jinxy are the only characters in the canon defeated by not being recognized. Some fans suggest that if they had been more famous, the gas would have worked. This is a theory.

title: Jinxy
subtitle: The other half of the ambush.
lead:
**Jinxy** is a character in *The Legend of Chris* who appears exactly once, as half of the duo that ambushed [[osama-bin-bomin|Osama Bin Bom'in]] with mustard gas as he left [[the-projects|the Projects]]. Osama, "not knowing who they we're", simply ignored the gas "and left without injury."

Jinxy's motives, appearance and fate are not recorded. Whether the name is a jinx in itself, given how the ambush went, is a popular topic of fan discussion.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.body: - Jinxy is always mentioned after [[qxc|QXC]], suggesting QXC was the senior ambusher.

title: George Constanta
subtitle: McQueen's roommate, until he wasn't.
lead:
**George Constanta** is a character in *The Legend of Chris* who took in [[lightning-mcqueen|Lightning McQueen]] after the [[moscow-bombing|Attack on Moscow]] left him "blasted". McQueen "moved in with George Constanta instead of returning by means of [[tyler-from-uber|Tyler from Uber]]."

It did not last. In [[chapter-triangle]], "Meanwhile in the Soviet Union, lighting McQueen was getting sick of George Constanta so he went to the airport and boarded a flight directed to England." What George did to cause this is never stated.

sections.heading: Behind the scenes
sections.body: The name is almost certainly a misspelling of George Costanza, the famously difficult character from the sitcom *Seinfeld*. If so, McQueen getting sick of him is the most realistic event in the canon.

title: The Projects Royal Family
subtitle: Royals of the Projects, mostly in exile.
lead: **The Projects Royal Family** is the royal house of [[the-projects|the Projects]]. It is mentioned once directly, in [[chapter-2]]: [[mf-vroom|MF Vroom]] "was a long lost relative of the project's royal family and was keen on returning to the top."

sections.heading: History
sections.body:
Nothing else is said about the family by name. However, later chapters strongly suggest royal loyalty is still alive. [[ioannus-paranukus|Ioann-ius Nukian]], a Jedi "of the projects", calls MF Vroom "my king", and [[son-s-sonionring|Son S. Sonionring]] describes Vroom's "palace" being stormed by [[osama-bin-bomin|Osama]] and his frat (see [[oblock-coup|The O'Block Coup]]).

Whether the family ruled before O'Block, or whether MF Vroom founded the dynasty while also being its long-lost relative, is a matter of debate. See [[mf-vroom|MF Vroom]] for the continuity discussion.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.body: - MF Vroom is a car. It is unknown whether the rest of the family are also cars.

title: I-38 West
subtitle: The heart of the Projects.
lead: **I-38 West** is a city described as "the heart of the projects". It is where [[steve-from-minecraft|Steve from Minecraft]] and [[quagmire|Quagmire]] met [[osama-bin-bomin|Osama Bin Bom'in]] in [[chapter-2]], and where their guide [[mf-vroom|MF Vroom]] was immediately exiled to the [[call-of-duty-lobbies|COD lobbies]]: "However once reaching the heart of the projects (the city of I-38 West) MF Vroom was send into exile".

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.body:
- The name sounds like a highway exit. Some fans believe the city is a highway exit.
- The city is not mentioned again. When the heroes return in [[chapter-4-point-1]], Osama lives in [[o-block|O Block 2]] instead, so the heart of the Projects may have moved.

title: The Projects
subtitle: Famed city. Gang-army superpower. Home of Facebook (Pre-Cringe).

quote.text: MF Vroom, if we can restore him to power in the projects we can harness the power of the gang army, more powerful than gang wars fueled by a new parks of nikes

lead: **The Projects** is a city-turned-nation in *The Legend of Chris*, introduced as "the famed city of 'the projects'". Ruled by [[osama-bin-bomin|Osama Bin Bom'in]] after he took it from [[mf-vroom|MF Vroom]], it is home to a gang army, a national spaceport, a national archive and a fleet of giant robots. Because its archives hold [[facebook-pre-cringe|Facebook (Pre-Cringe)]], it is one of the most strategically important places in the fight against [[chris|Chris]].

sections.heading: Geography
sections.body:
The Projects lies in [[united-state-of-america|The United State of America]] (singular). MF Vroom stresses this point: he refused to join [[european-union|the EU]] "because the Projects are in the americas not Europe".

Its heart is the city of [[i-38-west|I-38 West]]. Visitors arriving at the [[projects-national-spaceport|Projects National Spaceport]] approach through the treetops of [[adirondack-park|Adirondack Park]], during "a slow long turn, as fast as you could turn at mach 3". At street level, "Brick buildings and sketchy gas stations lined the roads." The city is overlooked by "giant defensive processing facilities that towered over the projects", one of which, [[dpf-facility-69420|DPF Facility 69420]], "looked like something out of neon genesis evongelian".

sections.heading: History
sections.body:
### Early history
According to [[son-s-sonionring|Son S. Sonionring]], he and MF Vroom "worked together to bring the O'block to its glory". MF Vroom is also described as a "long lost relative of the project's royal family" (see [[projects-royal-family|The Projects Royal Family]]).

### The O'Block Coup
Once O'Block "had a nation around it the frat bros rose up", led by Osama. When Vroom declined to join the EU, they "stormed his palace and gained complete control". See [[oblock-coup|The O'Block Coup]].

### Under Osama
In [[chapter-2]], Osama uses the Projects as the base for planning the [[moscow-bombing|Attack on Moscow]] with [[steve-from-minecraft|Steve from Minecraft]] and [[quagmire|Quagmire]], and exiles MF Vroom. During "the O'block 2 era, when It was being scaled to be a EU level nation", Osama built the [[ton-robots|TON robots]], including the flagship [[ton-618|TON 618]], "the projects flagship defense like Israel's iron dome but as one big robotic creature".

### The return
In [[chapter-4-point-1]], MF Vroom, [[rfk|RFK]], [[plankton|Plankton]], [[ioannus-paranukus|Ioannus Paranukus]] and Son land at the spaceport, flee [[police-kirks|Police Kirks]] in [[honda-accord-2005|Son's 2005 Honda Accord]], and head for O Block 2 while TON 618 wakes up. See [[spaceport-chase|The Spaceport Breakout & O'Block Chase]].

sections.heading: The gang army
sections.body: RFK's reason for recruiting MF Vroom is the Projects' gang army, "more powerful than gang wars fueled by a new parks of nikes". Restoring Vroom would put this army on the side of the [[new-crips|New Crips]].

sections.heading: National archives
sections.body: "We have Facebook (Pre-Cringe) in the national archives.. Its been one of our prize possessions since the nations inception, we're not quite sure how it got here, but under a build building, in the rubble we found it on a 67gb micro sd card." Facebook (Pre-Cringe) is one of the apps required by [[the-prophecy|the Prophecy]] to beat Chris. See [[projects-national-archives|The Projects National Archives]] and [[microsd-card|The 67GB MicroSD Card]]. (Moments later, someone calls it "the ssd", which it is not.)

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.body:
- [[ioannus-paranukus|Ioann-ius Nukian]], the Jedi master met at [[cod-hq|Call of Duty HQ]], is "of the projects".
- The book ends with the heroes approaching the palace at [[chicken-hour|chicken hour]], when "I doubt the guards will be looking out for us".
- Osama's ambassador for the country is [[tung-tung-tung-sahur|Tung Tung Tung Sahur]], who has a wooden body.

title: Moscow (Italian City)
subtitle: The Italian city of Moscow. Wine country, apparently.
lead: **Moscow** is described in *The Legend of Chris* as "the Italian city of Moscow", inhabited by "the italians of russia". It was the target of the [[moscow-bombing|Attack on Moscow]], carried out by [[lightning-mcqueen|Lightning McQueen]] on behalf of [[osama-bin-bomin|Osama Bin Bom'in]].

sections.heading: Controversy
sections.body: "This city was recently wrapped in controversy for hosting the September 2002 McDonalds Wine Brewing contest." The contest led to [[dairy-queen|DQ]] starting [[dq-mcdonalds-beef|beef on MySpace]] with [[mcdonalds|McDonald's]]. Because the [[myspace-relic-keepers|Keepers of the MySpace Relics]] wanted the beef over, they "wanted to level Moscow to shut McDonald's up and let DQ win already."

sections.heading: Aftermath
sections.body: After the attack, McQueen stayed nearby with [[george-constanta|George Constanta]]. His "work in Moscow" later becomes his reputation: [[agent-007|Agent 007]] tells him, "Ive heard stories about your work in Moscow I think your a Dope pick for the mission".

sections.heading: Continuity errors
sections.body:
- In [[chapter-2]] Moscow is an Italian city. In [[chapter-triangle]], McQueen leaves it "in the Soviet Union". Some editors say both are true, and the Soviet Union simply includes Italy now.
- In the real world, Moscow is the capital of Russia and is not famous for McDonald's wine.

title: The Attack on Moscow
subtitle: A fast-food dispute, escalated.
lead: **The Attack on Moscow** is an event in [[chapter-2]] of *The Legend of Chris*, planned by the [[myspace-relic-keepers|Keepers of the MySpace Relics]] against "the italians of russia". Its purpose was to end a [[dq-mcdonalds-beef|social media feud]] between [[dairy-queen|DQ]] and [[mcdonalds|McDonald's]].

sections.heading: Planning
sections.body:
[[steve-from-minecraft|Steve from Minecraft]] and [[quagmire|Quagmire]] traveled to [[the-projects|the Projects]] to "corrode-a-nate" the operation with [[osama-bin-bomin|Osama Bin Bom'in]]. The central question of the summit was "which Toyota Corolla should be responsible for the intital bombing run" (see [[toyota-corolla|The Toyota Corolla Question]]). The answer was [[lightning-mcqueen|Lightning McQueen]], "a chickfilla loyalist and a knight of 4chan".

The exit plan was to have [[tyler-from-uber|Tyler from Uber]] "Uber him out of there".

sections.heading: Motive
sections.body: Moscow had hosted the [[mcdonalds-wine-brewing-contest|September 2002 McDonald's Wine Brewing contest]], which led DQ to start beef with McDonald's on [[myspace|MySpace]]. The relic keepers "wasnt cool with this C tier beef" and wanted "to shut McDonald's up and let DQ win already." The canon does not explain how this would help DQ.

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The book reports the result in one sentence: "Sadly the attack on Moscow left lightning McQueen 'blasted' and moved in with [[george-constanta|George Constanta]] instead of returning by means of Tyler from Uber." No further details are given. The beef's status afterward is unknown.

sections.heading: Legacy
sections.body: McQueen's "work in Moscow" earned him a reputation with [[agent-007|Agent 007]], who recruited him for the [[fall-of-constantinople|Fall of Constantinople]]. This makes the Moscow attack the origin of the [[goober-gang|Goober Gang]].

title: September 2002 McDonald's Wine Brewing Contest
subtitle: The vintage that started a war.
lead: The **September 2002 McDonald's Wine Brewing Contest** was a competition held in [[moscow|Moscow]], "the Italian city". The book only mentions it as background: Moscow "was recently wrapped in controversy for hosting the September 2002 McDonalds Wine Brewing contest. This Which resulted in DQ starting beef on MySpace with Mac Donald's."

sections.heading: Analysis
sections.body:
The canon does not say who won, what was brewed, or why [[dairy-queen|DQ]] was upset. Leading theories include:
- DQ was not invited.
- DQ entered a Blizzard and was disqualified because it was not wine.
- Wine is not normally brewed, and DQ pointed this out.
None of these is confirmed.

The contest indirectly caused the [[moscow-bombing|Attack on Moscow]], making it one of the most consequential beverage events in the canon.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.body: - "Recently" refers to a 2002 contest. Since [[myspace|MySpace]] launched in 2003, the beef may have been waiting a year for a platform to happen on.

title: The DQ–McDonald's MySpace Beef
subtitle: C tier beef. Unacceptable.

quote.text: being keepers of the MySpace relics they wasnt cool with this C tier beef. So naturally they wanted to level Moscow to shut McDonald’s up and let DQ win already.

lead: **The DQ–McDonald's MySpace Beef** is a feud between [[dairy-queen|DQ]] and [[mcdonalds|McDonald's]] ("Mac Donald's") that took place on [[myspace|MySpace]]. It began after [[moscow|Moscow]] hosted the [[mcdonalds-wine-brewing-contest|September 2002 McDonald's Wine Brewing contest]], when "DQ starting beef on MySpace with Mac Donald's".

sections.heading: Escalation
sections.body:
The beef was rated "C tier" by the narrator, which in most traditions would make it ignorable. But [[osama-bin-bomin|Osama Bin Bom'in]], [[steve-from-minecraft|Steve from Minecraft]] and [[quagmire|Quagmire]], as [[myspace-relic-keepers|Keepers of the MySpace Relics]], felt responsible for the platform. Their solution was to bomb Moscow, the host city, "to shut McDonald's up and let DQ win already."

This makes the relic keepers neutral moderators who openly picked a side.

sections.heading: Status
sections.body: Unresolved. The book never confirms whether DQ won.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.body:
- This is the earliest recorded online beef in the canon, though [[lil-jokez|Lil Jokez]]'s SoundCloud diss tracks later rival it.
- The beef is called "C tier". The wiki has been unable to find the A or B tier beefs.

title: DQ (Dairy Queen)
subtitle: Started it.
lead:
**DQ**, or Dairy Queen, is a real-world ice cream and fast-food chain. In *The Legend of Chris* it is the party that started the [[dq-mcdonalds-beef|DQ–McDonald's MySpace Beef]] after the [[mcdonalds-wine-brewing-contest|McDonald's Wine Brewing contest]] in [[moscow|Moscow]].

Despite starting the beef, DQ had powerful backers: the [[myspace-relic-keepers|Keepers of the MySpace Relics]] wanted to "let DQ win already" and planned the [[moscow-bombing|Attack on Moscow]] to help. DQ itself never appears or comments, which some fans consider very professional.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.body: - DQ is only ever called "DQ" in the canon. Its full name appears nowhere in the book.

title: McDonald's
subtitle: Mac Donald's. Wine brewers. Beef haver.
lead: **McDonald's** (also "Mac Donald's") is the real-world fast-food chain. In *The Legend of Chris* it sponsored the [[mcdonalds-wine-brewing-contest|September 2002 McDonald's Wine Brewing contest]] in [[moscow|Moscow]], which led to [[dq-mcdonalds-beef|beef on MySpace]] with [[dairy-queen|DQ]].

sections.heading: Role in the canon
sections.body:
The [[myspace-relic-keepers|Keepers of the MySpace Relics]] took DQ's side and wanted "to level Moscow to shut McDonald's up". McDonald's itself did not respond, at least not on-page.

McDonald's appears again in [[chapter-triangle]], in what may be the most important clue in the hunt for [[chris|Chris]]. [[plankton|Plankton]] explains that traces of Chris have been found in [[reformed-travis-scott-sector|the Reformed Travis Scott Sector]], but "it will be hard to find exactly which planet in this system it is buying a mcdouble from". This means Chris eats at McDonald's, the very company the relic keepers attacked.

sections.heading: Fan theories
sections.body: - *The Chris–McDonald's alliance:* Some fans argue that Chris buying a McDouble proves McDonald's is aligned with him, which would explain why Osama, who "has connections with Chris", nevertheless bombed McDonald's interests. Others say Chris was just hungry.

title: Keepers of the MySpace Relics
subtitle: Guardians of a dead website. Heavily armed.
lead: **The Keepers of the MySpace Relics** is an order mentioned in [[chapter-2]]. Its three known members are [[osama-bin-bomin|Osama Bin Bom'in]], [[steve-from-minecraft|Steve from Minecraft]] and [[quagmire|Quagmire]]. "Being keepers of the MySpace relics they wasnt cool with this C tier beef", meaning the [[dq-mcdonalds-beef|DQ–McDonald's MySpace Beef]], and they planned the [[moscow-bombing|Attack on Moscow]] to end it.

sections.heading: The relics
sections.body: The book never says what the MySpace relics are. However, [[myspace|MySpace]] is one of the platforms whose "secret teachings" [[chris|Chris]] studied in the origin litany, and "MySpace v1.3.3" is one of the [[sacred-apps|sacred apps]] needed to defeat Chris in [[the-prophecy|the Prophecy]]. If the Keepers hold an early version of MySpace, they may be one of the most important factions in the canon without anyone in the book realizing it.

sections.heading: Fan theories
sections.body:
- *The relic is MySpace v1.3.3:* Since [[the-projects|the Projects]] already keeps [[facebook-pre-cringe|Facebook (Pre-Cringe)]] in its national archives, some fans believe Osama keeps MySpace v1.3.3 there too. This is a theory.
- *Tom:* The wiki will not speculate about Tom.

title: Knights of 4chan
subtitle: A chivalric order of the imageboard.
lead:
**The Knights of 4chan** is a knightly order mentioned exactly once in the canon, in [[lightning-mcqueen|Lightning McQueen]]'s introduction: "The Toyota Corolla to do the initial bombing run was to be lightning McQueen a chickfilla loyalist and a knight of 4chan."

Nothing else is known about the order: not its oaths, its leader, or how a car is knighted. 4chan is a real-world anonymous imageboard, so the order probably has no known members besides McQueen, which is the point.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.body: - McQueen holds two titles at once, also being one of the [[chick-fil-a-loyalists|Chick-fil-A Loyalists]]. Scholars debate which comes first on a Sunday.

title: Chick-fil-A Loyalists
subtitle: Loyal. Mostly.
lead:
**The Chick-fil-A Loyalists** are a faction known only through [[lightning-mcqueen|Lightning McQueen]], who is introduced as "a chickfilla loyalist and a knight of 4chan".

His loyalty is tested in [[chapter-the-fourth]]. While planting nukes in [[constantinople|Constantinople]], McQueen finds that his target has "actually now a Popeyes chicken location" and orders "two number 9s, a number 9 large a number 6 with extra DIEP a number 7 two number 45's, one with cheese, and a large soda", eating all of it before he leaves.

sections.heading: Analysis
sections.body: Loyalist apologists note that the Popeyes was a mission target, that Chick-fil-A was presumably closed, and that eating the order was technically reconnaissance. Critics note the order is very large.

title: The Toyota Corolla Question
subtitle: Which Corolla? And is it even a Corolla?
lead: **The Toyota Corolla Question** is the central problem of the [[moscow-bombing|Attack on Moscow]] summit: "they discussed which Toyota Corolla should be responsible for the intital bombing run." The answer: "The Toyota Corolla to do the initial bombing run was to be lightning McQueen".

sections.heading: Is McQueen a Corolla?
sections.body: In the real world, Lightning McQueen from Pixar's *Cars* is a custom stock car, not a Toyota. The canon is firm, though, and the wiki follows the canon. The question of how many Toyota Corollas Osama had to choose from is not answered.

sections.heading: Later vehicle confusion
sections.body:
The canon's car problems continue:
- In [[chapter-4-point-1]], [[plankton|Plankton]] yells at someone aboard the [[mercedes-benz-system-cruiser|Mercedes Benz System Cruiser]]: "Bro lowkey why r u built like a 2008 Honda accord Zyn weed addition". The subject is presumably [[mf-vroom|MF Vroom]], a car.
- Later, the heroes escape in [[son-s-sonionring|Son]]'s [[honda-accord-2005|2005 Honda Accord]].
- [[ton-618|TON 618]] then scans the city "looking for the Camry". The heroes are in a Honda Accord.

So the canon's major vehicles have been described as a Toyota Corolla, a Camry, a 2005 Honda Accord and a 2008 Honda Accord, and no two of these are the same car. Fans call it the Toyota Corolla Question because it has never been answered.

sections.heading: Fan theories
sections.body:
- *TON 618 is just bad at cars:* the Terrible Offensive Nuhuh may have been built without a car-recognition module.
- *All cars are McQueen:* not taken seriously.

title: Call of Duty Lobbies
subtitle: Exile. Forever. With voice chat.

infobox.Also called: COD lobbies, Xbox Live lobbies, xbox live 2009 lobbies

quote.text: you do know how barbaric the Xbox Live dungeons are, you could be burned alive by the 7 year olds screaming obscenities at you, or perhaps headshots from xbox 360 players with modded controllers

lead: **The Call of Duty Lobbies** (or "COD lobbies") are the place of exile in *The Legend of Chris*. In [[chapter-2]], [[osama-bin-bomin|Osama Bin Bom'in]] sends [[mf-vroom|MF Vroom]] there "to forever get yelled at in COD lobbies." It is considered one of the harshest punishments in the canon, because it is meant to last forever.

sections.heading: Location
sections.body: In [[chapter-triangle]], [[plankton|Plankton]] explains that to find MF Vroom "he would have to go to Call Of Duty HQ to locate him, and that itself as located deep into the heart of Dunder Mifflin." Inside the HQ, the lobbies are a scene of "madness": "gamers being yelled at for not capping red, xbox 360s red ringing in the middle of Cod tournaments." Beyond them are the [[chambers-360|360 chambers]], where "the screams and slurs of xbox live lobbies" echo down every hallway, "but no rooms".

sections.heading: Escape
sections.body:
MF Vroom is the only known escapee: "I escaped the COD lobbies but for days now ive been roaming these hallways trying to find a way out!" [[rfk|RFK]] later apologizes for interrupting "your epic mlg gaming session".

[[son-s-sonionring|Son S. Sonionring]] went into hiding after the exile "in fear that he too would have to listen to xbox live 2009 lobbies until his end", which dates the lobbies to 2009.

sections.heading: Behind the scenes
sections.body: *Call of Duty* is a real-world shooter series whose online voice chat, especially on the Xbox 360 around 2009, is famous for yelling. The Xbox 360's "red ring of death" hardware failure is also referenced.

title: Bon Jovi
subtitle: Conqueror of the Galactic Senate. Nuh Uh.
lead: **Bon Jovi** is a character in *The Legend of Chris* who conquered the [[galactic-senate|Galactic Senate]] on [[planet-patrick|Planet Patrick]] in the [[uniontown-system|Uniontown system]], and was then defeated by [[rfk|RFK]] after the longest argument in the canon. He shares a name with the real-world rock band and its frontman; the wiki documents only the canon version.

sections.heading: Biography
sections.body:
### The siege
"Meanwhile Bon Jovi has taken the galactic senate on the planet of Patrick in the Uniontown system. The battle was long and hard but Bon Jovi eventually had pushed out all of the 80 year old senators." See [[siege-of-the-senate|The Siege of the Galactic Senate]].

### The debate
One senator remained: RFK, "a Dark Knight", who told him, "It's over Bon Jovi I have 4 Red Bulls and a lightsaber, no one can mess with me I'm cool". "Bon Jovi looked around and proclaimed 'Nuh Uh'", starting [[nuh-uh-debate|the Great Nuh Uh–Yuh Huh Debate]], which lasts the rest of [[chapter-2]].

### Death
[[chapter-triangle]] opens: "Bon Jovi Died at the hands of RFK." How the debate became a death is not explained. Most scholars assume RFK won the argument.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.body:
- Bon Jovi says "Nuh Uh" 202 times, more than any other line in the canon is spoken.
- He is the only character whose last words are recorded about 200 times.
- The Projects' giant robot [[ton-618|TON 618]] stands for "Terrible Offensive Nuhuh". No link to Bon Jovi has been confirmed, but fans have noticed.

title: The Lost Society of Ballers
subtitle: Lost. Society. Ballers.
lead:
**The Lost Society of Ballers** is a secret order whose only known member is [[rfk|RFK]]. It is mentioned once, when [[plankton|Plankton]] approaches RFK in [[chai-town|Chai Town]]: "Are you RFK, part of the lost society of ballers?" RFK "stood there a moment wondering how this man knew his cool sad backstory" before confirming: "Yes I am who dares ask?"

The Society's purpose is never explained. Since [[chris|Chris]] "took balling all for himself" (according to [[mf-vroom|MF Vroom]]), the Society may be "lost" because there is no balling left for it to do. Plankton's mission, after all, is "universalizing Balling".

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.body: - RFK treats his membership as part of a "cool sad backstory", along with the loss of his adopted parents at a [[lil-uzi-vert|Lil Uzi Vert]] concert.

title: Lil Uzi Vert
subtitle: A concert with consequences.
lead:
**Lil Uzi Vert** is a real-world rapper who is mentioned exactly once in the canon, spelled "lilt uzi vert". After defeating [[bon-jovi|Bon Jovi]], [[rfk|RFK]] stands on the senate floor "remembering his adopted father and mother that died earlier that day at a lilt uzi vert concert."

Lil Uzi Vert does not appear in person and is not blamed for anything. The tragedy is part of RFK's "cool sad backstory", and is notable for happening on the same day as the [[siege-of-the-senate|Siege of the Galactic Senate]], making it a very busy day for RFK.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.body: - RFK has adopted parents, and [[plankton|Plankton]] is an orphan. Their partnership is sometimes called the Orphan Alliance by fans.

title: The Galactic Senate
subtitle: Formerly staffed by 80-year-olds.

infobox.Notable events: [[siege-of-the-senate|The Siege]], [[nuh-uh-debate|the Nuh Uh Debate]], [[chris-war-crimes|Chris's war crimes]]

lead: **The Galactic Senate** is a legislative body on [[planet-patrick|Planet Patrick]] in the [[uniontown-system|Uniontown system]]. It was taken by [[bon-jovi|Bon Jovi]], who "pushed out all of the 80 year old senators", leaving only [[rfk|RFK]].

sections.heading: History
sections.body:
### Chris's war crimes
The senate is also where [[chris|Chris]] once committed his war crimes. [[plankton|Plankton]] explains: "after his warcrimes in the galactic sentate his body was thought to be clones and thrown into a pit thought to have no end to it." See [[chris-war-crimes|Chris's War Crimes & the Cloning]] and [[the-endless-pit|The Pit With No End]].

### The siege and debate
In [[chapter-2]], Bon Jovi's long and hard battle for the senate ([[siege-of-the-senate|The Siege of the Galactic Senate]]) ended in a standoff with RFK and the [[nuh-uh-debate|Great Nuh Uh–Yuh Huh Debate]].

### Aftermath
In [[chapter-triangle]], after Bon Jovi's death, RFK "looked upon the senate floor wondering how he got there" and "decided that he had had enough and left then sentate." The senate's current membership is unknown and may be zero.

sections.heading: Behind the scenes
sections.body: The Galactic Senate is a reference to the senate in *Star Wars*, which also features [[jedi|Jedi]] and [[lightsaber|lightsabers]].

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.body: - It is spelled "sentate" twice.

title: Planet Patrick
subtitle: Home of the Galactic Senate.
lead:
**Planet Patrick** is a planet in the [[uniontown-system|Uniontown system]] and the seat of the [[galactic-senate|Galactic Senate]]. It is mentioned once: "Meanwhile Bon Jovi has taken the galactic senate on the planet of Patrick in the Uniontown system."

Nothing else is known about the planet. Some fans connect the name to Patrick Star from *SpongeBob SquarePants*, which would pair nicely with [[plankton|Plankton]], who appears in the very next chapter. This is a theory.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.body: - After the siege, [[rfk|RFK]] walks out of the senate onto streets near a corner store in [[chai-town|Chai Town]]. Whether Chai Town is on Planet Patrick is not stated.

title: Uniontown System
subtitle: A star system, presumably.
lead:
**The Uniontown System** is the star system containing [[planet-patrick|Planet Patrick]] and therefore the [[galactic-senate|Galactic Senate]]. It is mentioned exactly once, in the first sentence of the [[siege-of-the-senate|Siege of the Galactic Senate]]: "Bon Jovi has taken the galactic senate on the planet of Patrick in the Uniontown system."

In the real world, Uniontown is the name of several small towns in the United States. It is unknown whether the system was named after one of them, or whether they were all named after it.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.body: - It is one of several systems in the canon, along with [[kanye-system|the Kanye System]] and the [[reformed-travis-scott-sector|Reformed Travis Scott Sector]].

title: The Siege of the Galactic Senate
subtitle: Long and hard.

infobox.Result: Senators pushed out; standoff; Bon Jovi dies

lead: **The Siege of the Galactic Senate** is the conflict in which [[bon-jovi|Bon Jovi]] took the [[galactic-senate|Galactic Senate]] on [[planet-patrick|Planet Patrick]]. "The battle was long and hard but Bon Jovi eventually had pushed out all of the 80 year old senators. But one remained a Dark Knight named RFK."

sections.heading: The last senator
sections.body: [[rfk|RFK]] "used ancient battle tactics of the [[jedi|Jedi]] and was ready to fight back Bon Jovi." His declaration, "It's over Bon Jovi I have 4 Red Bulls and a lightsaber, no one can mess with me I'm cool", led directly into the [[nuh-uh-debate|Great Nuh Uh–Yuh Huh Debate]]. The siege ended at the start of [[chapter-triangle]]: "Bon Jovi Died at the hands of RFK."

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.body:
- The phrase "long and hard" is also used for the [[war-for-byzantine-mexico|War for Byzantine Mexico]] ("The war was long and hard"). Historians believe this is the canon's standard description of a war.
- The senators were "pushed out", not harmed. Bon Jovi's methods appear to have been mostly physical relocation.

title: The Great Nuh Uh–Yuh Huh Debate
subtitle: 303 utterances. One winner.

infobox.Result: Bon Jovi dies at the hands of RFK

quote.text: “Nuh Uh” “Yuh huh” “Nuh Uh” “Nuh Uh” “Yuh huh” “Nuh Uh” “Nuh Uh” “Yuh huh”

lead: **The Great Nuh Uh–Yuh Huh Debate** is the climax of the [[siege-of-the-senate|Siege of the Galactic Senate]] and the longest exchange of dialogue in *The Legend of Chris*. After [[rfk|RFK]] declared "It's over Bon Jovi I have 4 Red Bulls and a lightsaber", "Bon Jovi looked around and proclaimed 'Nuh Uh'", and the debate took up nearly a full page.

sections.heading: Structure
sections.body:
The debate opens with "Nuh Uh" "Yuh huh", and then settles into a strict pattern of two "Nuh Uh"s for every one "Yuh huh". By this wiki's count there are **202** "Nuh Uh"s and **101** "Yuh huh"s, an exact 2:1 ratio, for **303** utterances in total.

The 2:1 ratio has led to analysis. Since the book does not attribute the lines, the most common reading is that Bon Jovi is "Nuh Uh" and RFK is "Yuh huh". This means Bon Jovi spoke twice as often as RFK, and lost anyway.

sections.heading: Resolution
sections.body: The debate is not concluded on the page. [[chapter-2]] simply ends mid-argument, and [[chapter-triangle]] begins: "Bon Jovi Died at the hands of RFK." Whether the debate itself killed Bon Jovi, or whether RFK used his [[lightsaber|lightsaber]] or his 4 [[red-bull|Red Bulls]], is one of the canon's open questions.

sections.heading: Legacy
sections.body:
- [[ton-618|TON 618]], the Projects' flagship robot, stands for "Terrible Offensive Nuhuh". Fans consider this evidence that the "Nuh Uh" is a weapon.
- It is the clearest case of RFK's [[jedi|Jedi]] battle tactics in action, since the Jedi are also known for long conversations.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.body: - The page count of the debate is greater than the page count of the [[moscow-bombing|Attack on Moscow]], the [[fall-of-constantinople|Fall of Constantinople]] and the cloning of [[chris|Chris]] combined (the wiki has not measured this precisely).

title: The Jedi
subtitle: Ancient battle tactics. Also sold by the gram.
lead: **The Jedi** are an ancient order of warriors referenced in *The Legend of Chris*, borrowed from the real-world *Star Wars* franchise. Two characters are associated with the order.

sections.heading: Known Jedi
sections.body:
### RFK
During the [[siege-of-the-senate|Siege of the Galactic Senate]], [[rfk|RFK]], "a Dark Knight", "used ancient battle tactics of the Jedi and was ready to fight back Bon Jovi." He carried a [[lightsaber|lightsaber]], though he is never called a Jedi himself. A Dark Knight using Jedi tactics is considered unusual.

### Ioann-ius Nukian
In the [[dunder-mifflan-chapter]], a man smashes through [[openable-door|the OpenAble Door]] at [[cod-hq|Call of Duty HQ]] and introduces himself: "I Am Ioann-ius Nukian Jedi master and dealer of justice (I sell per gram, $40 a gram)". He is from [[the-projects|the Projects]], and wants to free his king, [[mf-vroom|MF Vroom]]. See [[ioannus-paranukus|Ioannus Paranukus]].

sections.heading: Jedi-like behavior
sections.body: Both RFK and [[steve-jobs|Steve Jobs]] claim to sense a disturbance, a classic Jedi ability. RFK: "I felt a disturbance in the Fabric in the Protestant universe". Jobs: "I felt a disturbance in the iCloud".

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.body: - Ioann-ius is the only Jedi in the canon with a listed price per gram for his justice.

title: Lightsaber
subtitle: Pairs well with 4 Red Bulls.

quote.text: It’s over Bon Jovi I have 4 Red Bulls and a lightsaber, no one can mess with me I’m cool

lead: The **lightsaber** is an energy sword wielded by [[jedi|Jedi]] and Jedi-adjacent characters in *The Legend of Chris*.

sections.heading: Known lightsabers
sections.body:
### RFK's lightsaber
[[rfk|RFK]] brings a lightsaber, along with four [[red-bull|Red Bulls]], to his standoff with [[bon-jovi|Bon Jovi]]. It is not clear whether he used it, as the fight was settled by the [[nuh-uh-debate|Great Nuh Uh–Yuh Huh Debate]]. In [[chapter-4-point-1]], when the party is ambushed in the [[chambers-360|360 chambers]], RFK draws his [[hantavirus-vaccine|hantavirus vaccine]] instead.

### Ioann-ius's lightsaber
At [[cod-hq|Call of Duty HQ]], [[ioannus-paranukus|Ioann-ius Nukian]] jumps into the battle and "his lightsaber lit up a deep white". The narrator adds a brief, unnecessary note about which color it was not. In [[chapter-4-point-1]], "Ioannus drew his light saber" in the 360 chambers, and during the spaceport escape, "light sabers slicing" are part of a rapidly rising body count.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.body: - White lightsabers are rare in *Star Wars*. The canon does not explain why Ioann-ius has one.

title: RFK (Robert F. Kennedy Jr.)
subtitle: Dark Knight. Last senator. Drinker of G Fuel. Licker of rain.

infobox.Also called: RFK Jr., Ronald F Kennedy Jr. (by [[mf-vroom|MF Vroom]])

quote.text: why is RFK how is RFK, many are not pog like RFK

lead: **RFK** is one of the main protagonists of *The Legend of Chris*. Introduced as "a Dark Knight" and the last remaining member of the [[galactic-senate|Galactic Senate]], he defeats [[bon-jovi|Bon Jovi]], is recruited by [[plankton|Plankton]] to stop [[chris|Chris]], and decides that the way to do it is to rescue [[mf-vroom|MF Vroom]]. He shares a name with the American political figure Robert F. Kennedy Jr.; this article covers only what the canon says.

sections.heading: Biography
sections.body:
### The Galactic Senate
In [[chapter-2]], after Bon Jovi pushes out "all of the 80 year old senators", "one remained a Dark Knight named RFK. RFK used ancient battle tactics of the [[jedi|Jedi]]". He declares, "It's over Bon Jovi I have 4 Red Bulls and a lightsaber, no one can mess with me I'm cool", which leads to [[nuh-uh-debate|the Great Nuh Uh–Yuh Huh Debate]]. [[chapter-triangle]] opens with "Bon Jovi Died at the hands of RFK."

### A cool sad backstory
RFK then "pondered his existence" on the senate floor, "remembering his adopted father and mother that died earlier that day at a [[lil-uzi-vert|lilt uzi vert]] concert." He left the senate and bought [[g-fuel|G Fuel]] from "his favorite corner store that probably was involved with several gangs on the streets of [[chai-town|Chai Town]]."

### Meeting Plankton
Plankton found him and asked, "Are you RFK, part of the [[lost-society-of-ballers|lost society of ballers]]?" After learning about Chris, RFK says, "I haven't heard that name since [[operation-desert-storm|operation desert storm]] aired on cartoon network". He briefly considers [[mark-zuckerberg|Mark Zuckerberg]] as an ally, in a long tangent about cigars and Zuckerberg's cousin [[harry|Harry]], before deciding, "nah bro screw that we're gonna enlist MF Vroom."

### Dunder Mifflin
RFK and Plankton reach [[dunder-mifflin|Dunder Mifflin]] in their [[mercedes-benz-system-cruiser|Mercedes Benz System Cruiser]] ("Dear god.. its huge there's so much.. paper.."). At [[cod-hq|Call of Duty HQ]], RFK announces, "I felt a disturbance in the Fabric in the Protestant universe" (see [[protestant-universe|The Protestant Universe]]), and greets the battle inside with "What's up my meninges!"

### Freeing MF Vroom
In the [[chambers-360|360 chambers]], "RFK drew his hantavirus vaccine" when ambushed by what turned out to be MF Vroom. Outside in the rain, he warns that they might catch various things "if we stay out in the cold moist rain" while he "licks the rain off of his arm aggressively."

### The Projects
On the flight home, he explains the mission to MF Vroom. During the car chase through [[the-projects|the Projects]], he asks whether there is roadkill, as he needs a raccoon part "for my next dish", and [[son-s-sonionring|Son]] asks why he wants "to cook up some new Kennedy food" in the middle of a police chase. At the end of the book, he sums up the TON 618 situation: "W-well shoot".

sections.heading: Personality
sections.body: RFK refers to himself in the third person in moments of reflection, and is easily impressed ("Cool", "Baller, so theres only one then?"). In [[chapter-4-point-1]], he begins to stutter ("t-t-t-this is really cool guys", "N-n-now mister Vroom", "Who was that-t?", "I-it is extremely important"). The cause is unknown; some fans blame the rain.

sections.heading: Equipment
sections.body:
- 4 [[red-bull|Red Bulls]] and a [[lightsaber|lightsaber]], his arsenal against Bon Jovi.
- A [[hantavirus-vaccine|hantavirus vaccine]], drawn as a weapon in the 360 chambers.
- A modded nerf gun, retrieved from the cruiser at the spaceport.
- G Fuel, which he drinks on the way to his destiny.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.body:
- RFK and Plankton are both effectively orphans: RFK lost his adopted parents, and Plankton has "no last name" because he is one.
- MF Vroom calls him "Ronald F Kennedy Jr.", and he does not correct him.
- He is a "Dark Knight" in a canon that also contains [[drake-batman|Drake Batman]]. No connection has been established.
- His "disturbance in the Fabric" line is later echoed by [[steve-jobs|Steve Jobs]]'s "disturbance in the iCloud".

lead: **Plankton** is one of the main protagonists of *The Legend of Chris*. Known to [[mf-vroom|MF Vroom]] as "Plankton from the hit show SpongeBob square pants", he has no last name, as he is an orphan. He recruits [[rfk|RFK]] to find [[chris|Chris]], co-leads the expedition into [[dunder-mifflin|Dunder Mifflin]] to free MF Vroom, and answers to no one.

sections.heading: Biography
sections.body:
### Recruiting RFK
In [[chapter-triangle]], Plankton approaches RFK in [[chai-town|Chai Town]] and introduces himself. He then tells RFK about "a Man so infamous that almost no one dares to utter his name… His Name…. Is Chris: All balled up Deluxe Edition."

Plankton gives the canon's most detailed account of Chris's fate: "after his warcrimes in the galactic sentate his body was thought to be clones and thrown into a pit thought to have no end to it." Chris's soul stayed in the first body "because our all knowing overseers declared it the less wack one" (see [[all-knowing-overseers|The All-Knowing Overseers]]). Since "the crash of the housing market in 2007/2008" ([[housing-crash|The Housing Market Crash]]), Chris has been lost, but there are traces in [[reformed-travis-scott-sector|the Reformed Travis Scott Sector]], where he is buying a McDouble from an unknown planet.

When RFK proposes MF Vroom, Plankton considers it and agrees: "Aight Bet". See [[aight-bet|"Aight Bet"]].

### Dunder Mifflin
After a month-long trip, Plankton announces their arrival at Dunder Mifflin. His plan to get past the [[google-smart-guards|Google Smart Guards]] is to go "through the sign" ([[the-sign|The Giant LED Sign]]), since its wires are "So big", "bigger than big". At [[cod-hq|Call of Duty HQ]] he says, "Insert and his name is john cena here" (see [[john-cena|John Cena]]). When [[ioannus-paranukus|Ioann-ius Nukian]] confronts them, Plankton replies with the canon's most poetic speech: "Some might say we wish to free all chains that bind us, and some chains that blind us". At the fingerprint scanner, he "proceeds to walk through the door with the fam because he answers to no one."

### The 360 Chambers
In [[chapter-4-point-1]], ambushed by a shadowy figure, "Plankton drew his metal folding chair" and threw "his average sized metal chair" before learning it was MF Vroom. When a door appears, he notes, "Obama care did not reach this door". In the rain outside, he says "Bro let me get some of this" and "licks RFK's shoe in theory."

### The Projects
Plankton comments on the cruiser's turn toward the [[projects-national-spaceport|Projects National Spaceport]] ("pretty dope pog if you ask me"). After [[son-s-sonionring|Son]] shoots [[tung-tung-tung-sahur|Tung Tung Tung Sahur]], he says, "Well that sorts out that fat L issue". When a blue glow appears at [[dpf-facility-69420|DPF Facility 69420]], his instincts as a veteran of [[fortnite-island-wars|the Great Fortnite Island Wars]] take over and he chants "Fornite battle pass, I just-". The book ends with Plankton saying "Aight bet" once again.

sections.heading: Personality
sections.body: Plankton is calm, decisive, and above authority. He is the only character confirmed to walk through a fingerprint scanner without scanning. He has a talent for exposition and for short, final decisions.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.body:
- Plankton's "no last name" line is his best-known quote, despite his last name never being asked for.
- He says "Aight Bet" at the end of [[chapter-triangle]] and at the end of [[chapter-4-point-1]], which is also the end of the book.
- In the real show, Plankton is a tiny villain who runs the Chum Bucket. The canon never mentions the Chum Bucket.
- He yells at someone in the cruiser, "Bro lowkey why r u built like a 2008 Honda accord Zyn weed addition". See [[toyota-corolla|The Toyota Corolla Question]].
